description: This file defines the OrderStatusHistory entity for tracking changes in order statuses within an e-commerce system. It includes fields for order reference, status, timestamp, customer notification, and comments, along with necessary JPA annotations for ORM mapping.

classes.name: OrderStatusHistory
classes.description: Entity representing the history of status changes for an order, with fields for status, date, notification, and comments.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the primary key ID of this order status history record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the primary key ID for this record.

methods.name: setOrder
methods.description: Associates an Order object with this history record.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the order status at this record.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the order status at this record.

methods.name: getDateAdded
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the status change was recorded, with cloning for safety.

methods.name: setDateAdded
methods.description: Sets the timestamp for when the status change occurred.

methods.name: getCustomerNotified
methods.description: Returns the integer indicating if the customer was notified.

methods.name: setCustomerNotified
methods.description: Sets the notification status for the customer.

methods.name: getComments
methods.description: Returns any comments associated with this status change.

methods.name: setComments
methods.description: Assigns comments to this status change record.
